resumos: 结合 Elasticsearch 的 BM25 关键词检索与 Sentence‑Transformers 生成的向量相似度进行联合评估。

A framework for generating high-quality sentence embeddings for semantic search tasks.
A Python framework for generating sentence embeddings with pre-trained models for multilingual support.
